_about: Every finance document, with the facts version-aware search needs. Dates for official documents are taken from the documents themselves; null means not yet checked. effective_from = from when the content applies (as the document states). published_at = when it was issued. supersedes = ids this document repeals or replaces. A listed file that is not in the folder yet is skipped when indexing.

documents.title: Cirkulaere om satsregulering pr. 1. januar 2025 for tjenesterejser (Medst. 056-25)
documents.note: Checked in the PDF on 30 Oct 2026: dated 4 April 2025, applies from 1 Jan 2025, repeals circular 9216 of 20 March 2025 (Medst. 040-25, not in this corpus). Denmark hotel 1,900 DKK (reduced 1,425), mileage 2.23/3.81 DKK per km, Danish daily allowance 513.00, hourly 21.38, daily allowance abroad 597. Footnote: the Danish hotel amount follows the state hotel agreement, adjusted 15 March each year.

documents.title: Cirkulaere om satsregulering pr. 1. januar 2026 for tjenesterejser (Medst. 007-26)
documents.note: Checked in the PDF on 30 Oct 2026: dated 27 March 2026, applies from 1 Jan 2026, repeals 006-26. Denmark hotel 1,956 DKK (reduced 1,467, p. 15); footnotes: the amount follows the state hotel agreement adjusted 15 March each year, and hotels on the state agreement above the amount can also be reimbursed. Whether 1,956 applies to nights before mid-March 2026 is for the finance office to confirm.
